title: Ordinary semilinear system calculus and cartesian internal Hom
statement: For an essentially small site C with independent site and coefficient universes and any inverse sequence B of commutative ring sheaves, the ordinary derived category of modules on the ringed sequence site has a Data structure as in [def-coef-semilinear-derived-calculus], together with its HomReductionFormula. This includes Grothendieck abelianness, componentwise exactness, exact and jointly conservative derived evaluation, normalized scalar adjunctions and their reduction cocycle, representative-normalized tensor and cartesian-input internal Hom, and the displayed Hom transition law. No geometric morphism, open localization or compatible second ring tower is part of this result.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21, and Lemma 4.10, printed pp. 23-24; the ordinary ringed-topos-of-systems construction and its evaluation adjunction, generalized here from quotient constant rings to ring sheaves. Other operations use Stacks Tags 06YS, 06YY, 07A4, 07A6, 08J7-08JB. This is the ordinary-derived-route restatement requested by the human, 2026-10-18 (coord/returns/NF.md).

proof.text: Apply the independent-universe K-injective-resolution theorem on the constructed sequence site to obtain Grothendieck abelianness. Exact evaluation is already constructed. Its restrictions jointly detect zero objects by sectionwise extensionality; commutation with short-complex homology proves componentwise exactness. The underlying presheaf functor reflects isomorphisms, so ordinary evaluations jointly detect isomorphisms. Commutation of the exact derived evaluation with homology and the derived cohomological isomorphism criterion prove joint detection in the derived category. The exact-functor construction supplies the commutation with shifts and triangulatedness.

Choose the scalar coherence, then its normalized tensor coherence, then the cartesian-Hom evaluation comparison. Assemble these structures with the preceding directly proved fields into Data. All scalar, tensor and Hom data are actual functors on the fixed ordinary derived categories; no replacement of these categories is made.

Prove naturality of each reduction by applying its scalar-adjunction Hom equivalence to naturality of derivedTransition. For H = RHom(M,N), apply tensor-reduction compatibility to (H,M), and compose with inverse tensor-evaluation comparisons. Naturality of reduction for system evaluation identifies the resulting map with scalar extension of the level-m evaluation followed by reduction of N. The normalization of the two Hom evaluation comparisons rewrites this as a square involving the tensor of the Hom reduction with the cartesian reduction of M. Apply the tensor-Hom adjunction at level n and cancel tensor with the cartesian reduction (an isomorphism). Naturality of scalarTensor and cancellation of the cartesian reduction against its inverse give exactly homReductionTranspose, including both Hom comparison maps. This establishes HomReductionFormula and hence SemilinearSystemData.

proof_origin.place: Construction 4.1 and Proposition 4.17(a); Q1 writes the componentwise/derived detection argument and the tensor-Hom transposition in Lean, separating the three construction steps.
